title: Increase Hair Density for Thinning Hair | SMP and Hair Transplant

hero.heading: Boost Hair Density for Thinning Hair – With or Without a Transplant
hero.subtitle: Whether you've already had a hair transplant or are just exploring options – there's a way to enhance the appearance of density. But it's important to understand the limitations.

sections.title: Hair Transplant – What It Can and Can't Do
bullets: Goal: Fill in affected areas with new growth
Reality: Sometimes there isn’t enough hair for full coverage
Donor area doesn't provide enough grafts
Scars from the procedure are noticeable
text: A hair transplant is a surgical procedure in which hair follicles from the donor area (usually the back of the head) are transplanted to balding areas.
Many patients are disappointed after a transplant – either due to poor results or unrealistic expectations. But there’s a solution that can complement it.

sections.title: Scalp Micropigmentation (SMP) – A Visual Trick for Thicker-Looking Hair
bullets: Lasts 2–4 years without surgery or downtime
text: SMP is a non-invasive procedure using pigments to create a shadowing effect on the scalp that mimics the look of denser hair. Up close, it's micro-dots; from a distance, it's the illusion of depth that reduces the contrast between skin and hair.

sections.title: Important: SMP Has Its Limits
text: SMP is a two-dimensional solution – it works visually, not physically. It doesn’t add volume but creates the optical illusion of a denser hairline.

If you have large completely bald areas, SMP can’t simulate a full, three-dimensional hairstyle. But it can dramatically improve appearance, reduce contrast, and create seamless transitions between hair and scalp.

sections.title: Combination of SMP + Transplant = Best Results?
bullets: SMP fills visual gaps between grafts
Blends areas with sparse or uneven growth
Reduces the need for additional surgeries
Visually boosts density in thinning hair
Complements poor or partial transplant results
Ideal for those not eligible for a transplant
text: For many, combining transplanted hair with SMP is the key to a complete look.
After SMP, many of our clients are satisfied with their appearance for the first time.
